response.sql: SELECT s2.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s1.gbsize / NULLIF(s1.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans s1 JOIN sites s2 ON s1.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry WHERE s1.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s1.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s1.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s1.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s2.riskeval

assumptions.assumption: The average is the mean of each scan's own gbsize/spanmin ratio, not total size divided by total minutes.
The date range includes both endpoints and is compared as plain text, as the request says.
Scans with a null gbsize or spanmin are left out. Scans with spanmin of 0 give a null ratio through NULLIF, so they are ignored instead of causing a division error.
Sites with a null riskeval form their own group, shown with a null status.

alternatives.interpretation: Use the pooled ratio for each status: total gbsize divided by total spanmin, instead of the mean of per-scan ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT s2.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, SUM(s1.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s1.spanmin), 0) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans s1 JOIN sites s2 ON s1.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry WHERE s1.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s1.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s1.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s1.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s2.riskeval
